echo "exit=$?"

set +e
printf '%s\n' '--- api help ---'
herdr api --help 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- agent attach help ---'
herdr agent attach --help 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- pane read help ---'
herdr pane read --help 2>&1
